steps.name: Plan and token estimate
steps.about: Work out the steps and how many tokens the whole job takes.
steps.detail: About 3–5 million tokens in all (mostly re-reading), ~150k written

steps.name: Get the Windows program shell
steps.about: Download Electron for Windows: a ready-made program window with a web engine inside, so the game runs the same as in the browser.
steps.detail: Electron 45.2.2 for Windows downloaded, checksum matches

steps.name: Game server inside the program
steps.about: The program carries the game server, so whoever opens it can host.
steps.detail: Server starts inside the program when you click HOST

steps.name: Host or Join screen
steps.about: First screen: HOST to start a game on this computer, or type a friend's address and JOIN.
steps.detail: HOST / JOIN screen with recent addresses written

steps.name: Full screen window and keys
steps.about: Opens full screen, F11 switches to a window, Quit to desktop closes it.
steps.detail: Full screen, F11, Quit closes the program

steps.name: Saved profiles in the friend's own folder
steps.about: Each friend's profiles and settings are kept on their own computer.
steps.detail: Saved in %APPDATA%\R62D\data on each friend's PC

steps.name: Build R62D.zip
steps.about: Put it all together into one file to download.

steps.name: Test it like a Windows PC would
steps.about: Run the .exe under Wine (Windows emulation) and check host, join and a match.
steps.detail: In Wine: start screen, HOST, the game menus and a free-play match all work; Quit closes it

steps.name: Browser version still works
steps.about: Run the usual game tests so nothing broke in the browser version.
steps.detail: Bot match on Harbor Office and free play test both PASS

steps.name: Download link on GitHub
steps.about: Upload R62D.zip to your GitHub Releases page for your friends.
